answer: You basically rotated through one service at a time rather than stacking them up: Crunchyroll back in January (the rainy-weekend anime backlog, hunting for decent dubs), then in late April you cancelled the one you'd stopped opening and moved to MUBI for the one-curated-film-a-day thing. By the end of August you were on Shudder for your early spooky season, and in December you switched over to BritBox so your mum would have her vicar-solves-the-crime murder mysteries during her three-week stay.
